verdict.rationale: smolagents is a framework for building code/tool-calling agents rather than an end-user product with built-in data stores; however examples like the text_to_sql demo show agents generating data analysis insights (SQL queries, plots) via code execution, which is the closest analog to 'AI-generated insights from data'. Missing for 10: a first-party 'insights' or dashboard feature operating on a user's own data within a shipped product, and independent verification beyond the single community anecdote (which also notes a partial failure needing a workaround).
